summary: Five checkboxes where Shift+click selects the whole range from the last clicked row, using the forwarded onclick and data-testid.
use: Lists and tables with row selection that need Shift range selection.
spec: `onclick={(e) => (shift = e.shiftKey)}` is forwarded to the input and runs just before `onchange`
`onchange={(on) => toggle(i, on)}` applies the state to every row between the anchor and the clicked row when shift was held
Footer line counts the selected rows
